title: Checkpoint II: Longest Stable Segment
prerequisite: Lessons 7–10. The relevant pattern is intentionally not announced.
hints: Maintain a window containing at most allowedKinds distinct identifiers; adding a new right value can make the window invalid.
Track counts inside the window so moving the left boundary can remove an identifier exactly when its count reaches zero.
Expand right, shrink left while the distinct count is too large, and update the best length after validity is restored.
